text_block_list.text: Today is the Shundai Festival. I came to see how Gold City is doing with her performance, but...
choice_data_list: (She's definitely nervous...)
(She looks nervous...)

text_block_list.text:
She's likely tense out of a sense of responsibility.
If only I could ease it even a little before the race...
Just as I was struggling to find a way—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Things are heating up.
Though I doubt we'll be able to see it this year.
choice_data_list: ...I want to check out the festival!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: Could you show me around the venue?
Could you show me around the venue?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...My race is coming up real soon.
You get that I need to focus, right?"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: "Besides, you can go to a festival alone. It's not like you're a kid..."
choice_data_list: It's an Umamusume festival, so I thought you might know more about it.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Well, maybe so, but...
...No way. I'm not going."
choice_data_list: Please!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
No way, I don't wanna.
—I'm definitely not going.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
choice_data_list: What should we look at first!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I really underestimated just how persistent this one is.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...It's not like we have all day.
You decide."
choice_data_list: I want to see the portable shrine!
I want to see the whole festival from above!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
A portable shrine, huh?
...Well, guess we can go check it out.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
That's huge...
Pulling this thing is gonna be brutal.

text_block_list.name: Caretaker Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like,
would you like to try leading him for a bit?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Huh. But isn't it sacred?
Wouldn't it cause trouble if we moved it?

text_block_list.name: Caretaker Umamusume
text_block_list.text: It's certainly precious, but there's no rule against merely touching it, so don't worry.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...?
Well then, just a little bit...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Huh—!?
Ngh, nnnngh...! So heavy...!!

Gold City pulls the portable shrine with all her might.
However, it didn't budge even a single millimeter...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... Haa...

text_block_list.name: Caretaker Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it's pretty tough, isn't it?
It takes over a dozen Umamusume just to budge this thing,
so it's impossible all on your own.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...
...Can we do it just one more time?

text_block_list.name: Caretaker Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Huh? But—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine, just one more time...!
...All right!
It seems her competitive spirit was ignited, and Gold City continued to challenge it boldly afterwards—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
—Phew... Nnnngh!!
Mmmhhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Ngh... damn it...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"—Aaaargh!
Jeez!"

text_block_list.name: Caretaker Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"U-Umm, City-san.
You should probably give up by now—"
choice_data_list: ...All right, leave it to me!
...All right, leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Wha...
I'm telling you, that's impossible!

Following Gold City's lead, I pulled the portable shrine with all my might.
Of course it wouldn't budge, but refusing to give up and continuing to pour all my strength into it resulted in—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you okay...?
You're wobbling on your feet, though...
choice_data_list: *Pant*, *wheeze*, *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Pfft. Don't look at me.
The look on your face right now is too funny...!
choice_data_list: ...*pant*! *gasp*!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ngh! Stop looking!
My face looks seriously awful right now...!
Pfft... Ahaha!

...Though not in the manner originally intended,
it ultimately succeeded in easing
Gold City's tension.

Stepping away from the crowd for a bit
might help ease her tension.
Thinking so, I made the suggestion.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"You came all the way out here,
and you're already bored? That was fast."
choice_data_list: First, I want to watch over them from afar!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Normally, aren't you supposed to save that for the end?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Well, fine by me.
As for a place with a good view—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
—Hmm... Is the festival around there?
Maybe I went a bit too far.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Still...
Phew~...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: The atmosphere feels totally different from earlier.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...So, how is it?
Here's the view you wanted."
choice_data_list: ...That light is crazy bright!
...That light is crazy bright!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Talk about sloppy.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, look.
Isn't it about time you told me the real reason?"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
You had another reason
for wanting to come here, didn't you?

Seeing as there was no longer any point in trying to hide it,
I decided to answer honestly.
choice_data_list: I wanted to take City out with me

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Why?
choice_data_list: I wanted to help ease your nerves.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...I was tense, sure.
Though you could've just told me right then and there."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's just that,
I still...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...You know, you're pretty clumsy, or rather...
you sure worry about the weirdest things.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm glad I got some fresh air.
I feel kind of refreshed now.
choice_data_list: Give it your all and have fun out there!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...Hmph.
You don't need to tell me that."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I'll do the job I was asked to do, no cutting corners.
I'll even surpass whatever you're imagining—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I'll shine so bright
you'll be able to see it even from here.
True to those words, Gold City went on to brilliantly demonstrate her true ability in the actual race.
